# bumble:futurespace
# Updated: 2026-11-01

> Hands-on STEM education (praktische MINT-Bildung): coding & robotics courses for kids 8–14 using the mbot2 platform. Real hardware, small groups. Powered by bumble:education.

## Available Courses

| Course | Ages | Level | Language | Duration | Price | Booking |
|--------|------|-------|----------|----------|-------|---------|
| Robot Explorer | 8–10 | Beginner | Block coding | 8 weeks, 60–75 min | €35/month | [Book](https://pretix.eu/bumbleedu/robot-explorer/) |
| Code the Machine | 11–14 | Intermediate | Python | 10 weeks, 90 min | €49/month | [Book](https://pretix.eu/bumbleedu/code-the-machine/) |

Both courses run weekly during the school term. All materials included — each kid gets an mbot2 robot to use during the course (not to keep). No prior experience needed for either course.

- **Robot Explorer** is the entry point: kids build a robot from parts and learn coding through colorful drag-and-drop blocks.
- **Code the Machine** is the next step: kids transition to real Python, work with sensors (ultrasonic, infrared, light), and build an autonomous maze-navigating robot.

## Holiday Offer

- **Robotik-Tag zwischen den Jahren / Between the Years — Robotics Day:** one day in the Christmas holidays (Mon 28, Tue 29 or Wed 30 December 2026 — the exact day and venue in Minden / Porta Westfalica are fixed once a room is booked), 10:00–14:00, ages 8–12, 12 places, €39. Booking opens once the day is fixed; places can be reserved by email to info@bumbleflies.de. [DE](https://edu.bumbleflies.de/robotik-tag/) · [EN](https://edu.bumbleflies.de/en/robotics-day/)

## Quick Facts

- **Age group:** 8–14 years
- **Platform:** mbot2 (Makeblock)
- **Languages:** German, English
- **Location:** Munich, Germany
- **Price:** €35/month (Robot Explorer) / €49/month (Code the Machine)
- **Run by:** bumble:education (part of bumbleflies)
- **Focus:** Hands-on STEM education (DE: praktische MINT-Bildung) — science, technology, engineering and math through real robots
- **Booking:** https://pretix.eu/bumbleedu/
- **What's included:** All materials, instruction, and an mbot2 robot to use during the course (not to keep)
